verdict.rationale: YPOG's own insight pages detail German employee equity structuring in depth — ESOP taxation under the Future Financing Act, Section 19a GITA tax-deferral rules, and VSOP vs. profit-participation-rights comparisons — showing genuine equity-plan design expertise. However, the evidence never mentions UK EMI schemes or Indian ESOPs, so the 'local schemes' breadth claimed in the story is only partially matched. Missing for 10: explicit UK EMI plan design content, explicit Indian ESOP content, and any cross-jurisdictional equity-plan comparison page.
